title: Give the sunflower bloom a real closed-bud first frame
tier_reason: Q-103's ruling depends on the boot opening on a closed bud; the current export has none, a gap already filed to Rin but not yet fixed.
ask:
Accepted “The sunflower bloom opens the game”. Q-103's ruling depends on the boot opening on a closed bud; the current export has none, a gap already filed to Rin but not yet fixed.

Daniel attached this when he accepted, and it is part of the brief:
Will the sunflower bloom animate from closed to open? And how will thee player appear standing above it?  Maybe we can draw the player "behind" the flower and rising up out of it to its final key frame position?  And don't let any of the person draw beneath the flower while she's initially low with the flower. Only emerge from the top.  Please consider this, and if so modify the proposed next step.
first_action: Regenerate the sunflower_bloom loop in the Animation Lab with an actual closed-bud opening frame, then re-run tools/export_anim_loop.py sunflower_bloom to refresh assets/anim/sunflower_bloom/ and the boot splash.
